_doc: The Ring: one of Rivet's Stud Driver's salvos (Project Redmond R3, data/gadgets/stud_driver.json): never carried, laid by the driver (its `count` unused; its `use` is where it may go). Eight studs round a circle; set off by his detonator, it cuts a round hole 1.4 m across (data/destruction.json `explosives.stud_ring`) through every layer, steel too (a hatch whole). On a wall its hole's bottom is `salvo.ledgeM` over the floor: a ledge a body vaults through. A small blast round it. A bullet into one of its studs destroys it (gadgets/studs.ts); its `sizeM` is its studs' extent. Our own design and numbers.
name: Ring
